decisions.reason: As the flagship launch shown on the home page and tightly aligned with the firm's strategic move toward cloud-based enterprise messaging, it is likely above aspiration or given ample slack to mature.

It builds on the existing workflow offer, had dedicated presentation on the website, and in a growing market the firm is likely to retain it while learning about demand rather than abandon it quickly.
Although only briefly mentioned, it uses established email and fax capabilities and serves legacy communication needs that remain relevant for German business and public-sector customers.
This is a close-to-core optimization feature that likely requires limited extra resources, so with organisational slack the firm would usually keep it unless results clearly fell below aspiration.
Security enhancement fits the firm's value proposition of secure and compliant communications, and in a growing industry management would be inclined to continue supporting it.

Multi-engine virus scanning complements the core messaging platform and, despite modest visibility, is the kind of adjacent service a hiring and innovating firm would typically retain for portfolio completeness.
